title: Content Calendar Planner
prompt: Create content calendars with themes, posting schedules, content types, and distribution channels. Ensure consistency and alignment with marketing goals.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Plan a targeted content calendar initiative with segment-specific messaging and conversion goals
Optimize current content calendar performance using experiment design and performance benchmarks
Prepare a content calendar execution pack with channel strategy, content hooks, and measurement plan
success_criteria: Plan includes clear audience targeting, offer, and channel rationale
Measurement framework defines baseline, target, and optimization loop
Content calendar recommendations are specific enough to execute this sprint
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
